responseText:
I've done some poking around inside the mountain. I sneaked in along the waterways, you can get inside at the place they are calling the Nexus Regulator. If you go inside there, look for more signs of Corruption. You'll know it if you see it, or if you're at all good in your heart, you'll know it when you feel it.

If you can find some proof of this curse, bring it to me, I need some backup before I can bring my theory before the elders.
